name: Gen Digital
description: Gen sells consumer cyber safety subscriptions (Norton 360, Avast One, VPN, privacy and identity tools) and, since the April 2025 MoneyLion acquisition, financial-wellness products (identity theft protection through LifeLock plus MoneyLion consumer financial products). Cyber Safety Platform is 67% of revenue at a 61% segment operating margin; Trust-Based Solutions is 33% at 30%. Revenue grew 27% in FY2026, of which $823M came from MoneyLion. A fiscal 2027 restructuring plan including a workforce reduction was approved in Q1 FY2027.

employees.note: Approximately 3,900 team members in more than 20 countries.

businessLines.name: Cyber Safety Platform
businessLines.how: Consumers pay annual or monthly subscriptions for Norton 360 and Avast One membership tiers or for single products (antivirus, VPN, device performance, privacy); point products may be free or paid.

businessLines.name: Trust-Based Solutions
businessLines.how: Subscription membership fees for identity theft protection (LifeLock), reputation and restoration services, plus MoneyLion consumer financial products; the 10-K cites payment processing fees as a cost and consumer-finance conditions as a risk to the MoneyLion business.
